inventions: The wall's colour (ochre); the wayposts' mile counts; Vastin's account of declining the second reading at Norhold ('a lie I wrote in my own hand') — a new fact about Vastin's interior, no new institutional fact.
Lira's walk beside him and her own not-looking at the tops of walls.
state_change_proposals: Day 281: the last post short of the river; camp; Treswick 'tomorrow'. Cash 138.
Cael's finding: the reading is the wrong instrument for the still place (five readings; 'a cord on a stone'); he needs an instrument for what doesn't move; Karis's word 'how things are built' noted.

Vastin's confession: he declined the second reading at Norhold because he would not be the man who decided what the first meant; 'I let a boy carry my not-deciding across a continent as a piece of paper.' Cael did not forgive; was not asked to.
Cael told Vastin the one thing nobody holds: the instrument's nothing. No rank between them.
deviations: Vastin's confession about the declined reading is a new interior fact for him (consistent with B4/B6: he declined a second reading and 'sent it up'); flagged for the editor as invention within the budget's 'one true thing'.
